notes: Existing accepted GLB and native textures unchanged. Motion overlays use real rest-bone axes and a single continuously advanced base clip.

Cruise wave is calibrated to Porter et al. (2020), which measured 12.21 +/- 3.13 degrees posterior flexion, 8.28 +/- 1.74 degrees anterior flexion and 0.24 +/- 0.08 body-length peak-to-peak tail amplitude in volitionally swimming Carcharhinus limbatus.
Turn curvature is intentionally a conservative routine-turn inference from shark yaw-turn literature; it does not reproduce maximal escape turns.
Conservative head-centered envelope is verified from skin influence lever arms plus rest bone-chain path lengths during configure.
